# datahoard-cli

Command-line tool for efficient bulk data migration and archiving.

## Features
- High‑throughput ingestion from local and remote sources
- Pluggable transformation pipelines
- Incremental sync and deduplication
- Comprehensive audit logs

## Installation

```bash
pip install datahoard-cli
```

## Usage

```bash
datahoard migrate --config config.yaml
```

## Documentation

Full documentation is available in the `docs/` directory.

Report issues at https://support.example.com/datahoard
